tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bzhugs so/ /

rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod nas sangs rgyas rig pa'i klong yangs su/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos kun rnam dag pa/ /kun bzang dbye ba med la phyag 'tshal te/ /brtul zhugs dbang bsgyur spyod pa'i man ngag bstan/ / slob dpon chen po bi ma las rnam rtog thog rdzis su spyod pa'i man ngag gsungs pa'i don gcig tu bsdus te nyams su blang ba las/ rang gnad nges pa gsum las/ phyi yul gyi rang gnad dur khrod mtsho gling dang chu mdo dang ri la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre gnas sar phyin la/ 'di 'jig snyam pa zhig tu bsdad de/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs dang bcas pa byas la/ nang sems kyi gnad snang srid kyi lha 'dre thams cad bsams nas/ phung po dum brgya dum stong du bgos la byin nas tshogs su bsngo'o/ /phyogs phyogs gtor la/ rdul cha tsam yang ma lus par bsam mo/ /gnas lugs nyams len gyi gnad gang yang mi bsam ci yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang la glod nas nyal bas/ dngos dang gzi byin rmi lam gsum gyi cho 'phrul 'byung ste/ de ka dpyad bya'i don du shar bas/ rang gi sems kyis brtags shing sems la snang ba las gzhan ma yin sems nyid gdon du shar/ lhar shar/ 'khor 'das su shar yang*/ rang ngo la bltas pas stong sangs gtad yal nam mkha' lta bu mthong ste/ lha med 'dre med kyi rig pa rjen par mthong bas/ dpyad bya don gyi snying po mthong ba zhes bya'o/ /de'i dus su cho 'phrul ci tsam che yang rang rtsal ngar bskyed la gtad pas/ mi spangs la mi gnas par rang zhi ste/ tshar tshad zas nor ster ba la sogs dngos sam rmi lam du 'byung ngo*/ /gnyan sar rig pa lhongs dus/ chags sdang zug gzer/ nad gdon gyi zings thams cad/ rjen rjen ngos bzung ba'i ngang der mdung tshugs su nyams su blangs pas/ sngar gyi lam khyer rjen la phud nas rdo rus thug pa zhig 'ong ngo*/

/de nas gang du phyin/ gang du 'dug kyang*/ stong gsal rjen pa'i rig pa zang kar mthong bas/ chos go phyir ma shor bar rgyud la khel ba lags so/ /gnyan sa na 'gro dus/ gtor ma byin nas bsngo ba byas pas/ gzhi bdag stongs grogs su 'char zhing ci bsam lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /'di ni rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi nyams len gyi grogs su skabs su bya ba shin tu gces so/ /phyi yul snang lam slong gi spyod pa'o/ /nang rig pa lam slong gi spyod pa la gnad gsum las/ dang po rab tu dben pa'i lung stong du song la/ lus kyi gnad gcer bur phyung la/ snga ma'i sku sngo nag rab tu 'jigs par bsams pa'i spyi bor lam̐/ dpral bar e/ mgrin par kham̐/ lkog mar su/ snying nang du hūm̐/ nu mar ha/ lte bar ram̐/ rkang mthil du yam̐ rnams bsams la/ lus mchongs pa dang*/ rgyug pa dang*/ nyal ba dang*/ lang ba la sogs pa 'gro drug gi spyod pa sna tshogs bya/ ngag gi gnad de dag dang bstun la chags sdang dang*/ ngo tsha ba dang*/ chos ma yin pa dang*/ dud 'gro sna tshogs pa'i skad dang glu dang ngu ba la sogs pa bya/ sems kyi gnad chags sdang dgag sgrub/ nyon mongs/ bskyed rdzogs/ skyid sdug la sogs pa sna tshogs su spros la/ de ma thag rang ngo cer cer bltas pas/ rjes med du bun bun/ 'dzin med du sangs sangs ba 'byung*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi gnad sprug la nyin mo nyams su bla nga zhing mtshan mo bde ba'i mal du lus mi 'gul/ ngag mi brjod/ sems mi rtog par nyal la/ yang sang nyin snga ma ltar spyad/ rang nyid dug lnga gang rags pa de gtso bor bzung la tshar bcad pas rjes med rang yal du grol lo/ /de ltar dgag sgrub/ chags sdang re dogs/ blang dor gang byung ba/ da ltar gnas pa/ phyis 'byung ba thams cad dran pas bslangs la/ skad cig ma rang ngor rjen par blta zhing*/ rang shar rang grol du phyal phyal rtsal sbyangs pas/ dran rtog thams cad wal po rjes med du gtad yal nas/

lus sems dang bar snang 'dres pa mnyam pa dang/ med pa mnyam pa dang*/ phyam yas pa mnyam pa'i nyams 'byung zhing*/ chags sdang dang dgag sgrub thams cad dus 'dir zhig nas las can kha cig de nyid du grol ba de yod par yang gsungs so/ / spyod pa 'di 'khor 'das ru shan phyed pa zhes bya ste/ dge sbyor gyi rtsal sbyong dang bogs 'byin gyi gnad gal po che yin pas/ skabs skabs su de ltar nyams su len pa la brtson par bya'o/ /de ni thug phrad rang grol du lhongs pa dang*/ rkyen snang lam du lhongs pa dang*/ dran rtog chos nyid du lhongs pa dang*/ gang bsam bsam gtan du 'gyur ba dang*/ dngos 'dzin 'khrul ba 'jig pa dang*/ ka dag btsan sa zin pa la sogs pa yon tan du ma byed do/ e ma ho/ chos nyid rang bzhin rdo rje snying po'i chos/ /mngon sum snying tig zab mo'i gnad bsdus nas/ phyi rabs don du gsal bar bkod pa yis/ /ma lus 'gro kun mngon par sangs rgyas shog /chos tshul zhi ba sprin chen snying po las/ /bdud rtsi'i char gyis 'gro ba bsil bar shog /rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba/ theg pa rgyal po'i rnal 'byor pa sna tshogs rang grol gyis/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge'o/ / dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (11)rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa/ -PAGE 268--PAGE 269--PAGE 267-
